description_short: Live Train Network capacity and one grouped alert for sustained fleet jams.
description_long: Train Network Monitor See whether each Train Network has enough trains and get one clear alert when traffic stays jammed. Capacity dashboard Enable the optional dashboard in Mod Settings. It shows occupied / total trains, busy / total Waiting bays, and train counts for Unit, Loose, Fluid, Molten, Universal, Mixed, and generic formations. Only non-empty networks and wagon types are shown. The dashboard is off by default and stops updating when disabled. Jam alerts One grouped red alert appears when at least three trains and 10% of the active fleet remain blocked for the configured delay. Click it to cycle through affected trains, starting with the longest wait. Set the delay from 1–12 in-game months and optionally pause when a new alert starts. The alert clears when traffic recovers. The mod does not change train routing or behavior. Settings are stored per save. Works with base-game trains and the official Trains expansion.
